theorems.statement: If a divides b and b divides c, then a divides c
theorems.proof: Let a divide b and b divide c. Then there exist integers k and m such that b = ak and c = bm. Substituting the first equation into the second, we get c = (ak)m = a(km). Since km is an integer, a divides c. [QED]

theorems.statement: Every continuous function on a closed interval [a,b] is bounded
theorems.proof: Let f be continuous on [a,b]. Since [a,b] is closed and bounded (compact), by the Extreme Value Theorem, f attains its maximum and minimum values on [a,b]. Therefore, f is bounded. [QED]
